articles.title: Fox News host learns pigeons actually do lay eggs in brutal fact check to his face
articles.description: A Fox News anchor had to get a humiliating fact check from one of his guests after blundering on basic biology. Will Cain had on Matt DuBoise of Carolina Coops, a poultry coop manufacturer in North Carolina, to talk about boxing legend Mike Tyson's coop for pigeons — and he opened the segment by asking DuBoise, "Mike Tyson knows pigeons don't lay eggs, right?" After an awkward second, DuBoise said, "Uh, well actually, they — they do, but just not the chicken eggs that we want." "Ah!" said Cain, smiling as he recovered. Pigeons, like all birds, do in fact lay hard-shelled eggs. They're even edible, although they're not very commonly sold and fetch a hefty price due to the difficulties in producing them at scale. This isn't the first Fox News egg-related controversy. The network infamously hosted Trump administration Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Jenkins last year in the middle of a critical egg shortage, where she proclaimed people should just raise chickens in their backyards if they want cheap eggs.
